title: Alien eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- alien body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='24' ry='28' fill='#5FE3B0'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='24' ry='28' fill='#3CCF9A' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#8FF5CC'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='32' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#5FE3B0'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='28' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#8FF5CC' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#1A3A5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='32' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#1A3A5C'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='29' r='3' fill='#AEE8FF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='29' r='3' fill='#AEE8FF'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='38' y1='14' x2='32' y2='4' stroke='#3CCF9A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='4' r='4' fill='#FFD84D'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='14' x2='64' y2='4' stroke='#3CCF9A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='4' r='4' fill='#FFD84D'/>
  <!-- open mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='44' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#9B3F5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='46' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#E86B8A'/>
  <!-- snack: cookie being bitten -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='9' fill='#D9974E'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='9' fill='#C27A38' opacity='0.3'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='1.8' fill='#5A3B1E'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#5A3B1E'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='49' r='1.8' fill='#5A3B1E'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='1.3' fill='#5A3B1E'/>
  <path d='M54 40 Q57 46 54 52' fill='#48CC9A'/>
  <!-- arm holding snack -->
  <path d='M66 60 Q72 52 66 46' stroke='#3CCF9A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M30 60 Q22 54 18 48' stroke='#3CCF9A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M38 88 Q36 95 30 96' stroke='#3CCF9A' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 88 Q60 95 66 96' stroke='#3CCF9A' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='97' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#2EA57A'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='97' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#2EA57A'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='38' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF9BB5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='38' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF9BB5' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
